== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 30 June 2019. The Facebook photo viewer names Heath Scheiman. Identification: distinctive name plus Gold 75 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Cincinnati, Oh). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/heath.scheiman. The uncropped original includes a second person in the back seat; the lead crop is Scheiman alone.
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Heath Scheiman portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Heath Scheiman Facebook portrait.jpg]].
